title: Greenoaks among leads of Anthropic's Series H

sources.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.

explain: Greenoaks was one of four leads of Anthropic's $65 billion Series H (counted in full on the Sequoia record). Its own amount was not disclosed.
